name: Max Factor Salon
heritage: National Register of Historic Places contributing property; Los Angeles Historic-Cultural Monument
text: Max Factor Salon, formerly Hollywood Fire Safe Building, also known as Max Factor Building, is a historic four-story building located at 1666 N. Highland Avenue, Hollywood, California, just south of Hollywood Boulevard. It is best known for its more than five decade tenant Max Factor, and is currently home to the Hollywood Museum and Mel's Drive-In.

depictions.name: Max Factor Building
depictions.text: The Max Factor Building is a landmark in L.A. Noire. It is located in northwest Hollywood, on Highland Ave at the corner of Hollywood Blvd.
